firm_data.firm_description: Pechman Law Group represents workers and businesses in workplace disputes. They specialize in labor and employment law, handling discrimination, wage theft, harassment, employment contracts, prevailing wage, and overtime cases.
notable_facts: Represents both employees and management, providing a unique perspective on workplace dynamics.
Recognized by U.S. News’ Best Law Firms as a Tier 1 law firm in Employment Law for Individuals and Labor Law for Management.

additional_contacts.name: Lina Paulino
additional_contacts.title: Administrative Coordinator and a Senior Paralegal

email.to_title: Administrative Coordinator and a Senior Paralegal
email.subject: AI for Pechman Law Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Louis,

Representing both employees and management in complex workplace disputes takes deep expertise and efficient workflows. At Pechman Law Group, you're handling discrimination, wage theft, and employment cases that demand precision on both sides.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping firms compete without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
